yaps-meeting-transcription 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Create meeting transcripts with speaker labels using Yaps.
- Supports transcript correction, speaker assignment, export, and Q&A.
- Compatible with Yaps version 2.3.124 or newer.
- Multiple diarization engines supported: auto, sherpa (cross-platform), and moss (Apple Silicon).
- Detailed workflow and boundaries guide for safe and effective use.
